desc: Paper notes never take A (TTYD_NOTES_TEST, no relay; Rogueport's harbour): Mario stands by a gold note (+4), its balloon saying what opens it, and presses A: he jumps (the jump motion, 3) and the note stays shut; then L, the notes' button (the game's L, which Mario doesn't use in the field), opens it and L again closes it; then a tap on its sheet opens it again (a touch screen's, or the mouse's click)
log_must: ^\[notes\] near t0: Hidden a Star Piece\? \(\+4\)
^\[notes\] drawn: .*balloon t0; text 'Hidden a Star Piece\?'; text '\+4'; prompt '[^']+: Read'
^\[notes\] A by t0 was the game's: motion 3$
